Close-out 2026-11-19T11:40Z: PR #35464 MERGED as `edc5355dbd`; `Fixes` closed this card. Delivered: an install-local uninstall removes the package's entries from the shared seed-datasets list (the owner-keyed merge with an empty list), right after the running kernel's withdrawal succeeds; a refused uninstall or a refused kernel withdrawal leaves the list as it was. A composed artifact is owned by its entry id, so one withdrawal covers all its units. Organizations founded after the uninstall no longer replay its seed sets. L1-a ACCEPT 7006874426. Out of scope: none filed. `pm:dispatched` off.
